followup_ideas: The detached finish gc can run concurrently from many jobs finishing together; a non-blocking gc.lock to skip a gc while another is running would avoid redundant scans.
_drop_job_refs at job finish still waits on the job's own repo lock (behind another job's bundle fetch for the same repo); it could move to the detached gc, which already drops orphan job refs.
